description: Major capability inventory (#764 §1.1 coverage seed, reconciled against live repository reality at SOURCE_SHA). Reconciliation values: SAME/RENAMED/SPLIT/MERGED/NOT_APPLICABLE (a coverage-seed disposition, NOT an IR mapping_state value). Every family enumerates its real route/operation subset and every enumerated part carries a sanctioned mapping (capability→workflow→operation plus interface→operation) — the counts are derived from the capture, never hand-asserted. mapping_state records coverage only; support_summary is derived by the ATLAS-IR-032 roll-up from claims and is never hand-set here. Deep-review sample beyond the golden slices: candidate exam runtime (candidate-facing + durable state), audit (operational), proctoring (authorization-heavy), operations/diagnostics (operational + authorization boundary). Capabilities discovered beyond the seed are listed in beyond_seed_capabilities.

known_gaps: GET /api/invitations, POST /api/invitations, DELETE /api/invitations/:id are O-07 runtime-only (absent from the declared registry)
